comp-mragyryr.html:
Mahaavatar Narsimha is an animated feature film inspired by one of the most powerful narratives from Indian mythology. The project sought to bring a timeless story to contemporary audiences while positioning itself within a rapidly evolving animation and family entertainment landscape.

​

As the film prepared for its  journey, the challenge was not only awareness generation but also creating meaningful engagement among mythology enthusiasts, families, young viewers & cultural communities.

comp-mrah0h1l.html:
TSC Films worked alongside the project to design audience development and growth frameworks focused on long-term engagement. The process began with audience mapping and segmentation to identify key viewer groups most likely to connect with the film. This was followed by the development of engagement pathways that could strengthen audience participation throughout the film's lifecycle.

​

Our focus was on understanding the intersection of mythology, animation & family entertainment, allowing the project to communicate effectively across multiple audience segments.

comp-mrai7hgn.html: Mythological stories enjoy widespread familiarity in India, yet attracting younger audiences requires a different approach than traditional devotional or historical content.
